# Statlyx — Football Scouting & Intelligence Platform

> A high-performance sports analytics web application tracking 2,839+ professional football players across Europe's Top 5 leagues (Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1).

## System Architecture & Tech Stack
- Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, Vite 5, Tailwind CSS 3, Recharts, Framer Motion
- Data Architecture: Jamstack static JSON API endpoints generated via Python analytics pipeline
- Analytics Algorithms: Vector Cosine Similarity (k-NN) matching, Positional Cumulative Percentile Normalization, Levenshtein Fuzzy Entity Matching

## Core Features
- Master Player Roster: Search, filter by position/league/age, and sort by Highest Goals, Assists, Valuation, or Minutes.
- Athlete Scouting Profiles: Multi-axis radar skill profiles, historical market valuation curves, and similar player recommendations.
- Head-to-Head Comparison Matrix: Dual-polygon radar overlays, statistical leader badges, and valuation parity cards.
- League Intelligence & Performance Metrics: Top goal leader benchmarks, positional physical workloads, and biological age peak distribution histograms.

## Key Web Pages
- [Master Player Roster](https://statlyx.vercel.app/)
- [Head-to-Head Comparison](https://statlyx.vercel.app/compare)
- [League Intelligence](https://statlyx.vercel.app/insights)
